pros.title: brings polyphenols when fresh
pros.explanation: The bitter, peppery quality is part of the real extra-virgin advantage.

pros.title: mostly monounsaturated fat identity
pros.explanation: That gives it a different fat-quality role from many seed oils and animal fats.

pros.title: helps carry fat-soluble nutrients
pros.explanation: A little oil can make vegetable-heavy meals work better.

cons.title: quality drops with heat, light, and age
cons.explanation: The best part of extra virgin olive oil depends on freshness and storage.

cons.title: extremely energy dense
cons.explanation: It is still pure fat, so the calories arrive fast.

cons.title: easy to overpour without noticing
cons.explanation: Free-pouring can quietly add a lot more than intended.
